segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Good morning. World Tours. My name is Jamie. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: Good morning. I want some information on self-drive tours in the USA. Could you send me a brochure?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Of course. Could I have your name please?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: Andrea Brown.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Thank you. And your address?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: 24, Ardleigh Road.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Can you spell that?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: A-R-D-L-E-I-G-H Road.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Postcode?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: BH5 2OP

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Thanks. And can I have your phone number?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: Is a mobile alright?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Fine.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Thank you. And can I ask you where you heard about World Tours? From a friend? Or did you see an advert somewhere?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: No, I read about you in the newspaper.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: OK, I’ll get the brochures in the post to you but can I give you some information over the phone. What kinds of things do you want to do on your holiday?

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: I’m interested in going to California with my family. I’ve got two children and we want to hire a car.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: OK. We have a couple of self-drive tours there visiting different places of interest in California. The first one begins in Los Angeles and there’s plenty of time to visit some of the theme parks there.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: That’s something on my children’s list so I’d like to include that.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Good. Then you drive to San Francisco. From San Francisco you can drive to Yosemite Park where you spend a couple of nights. You can choose to stay in a lodge or on the campsite.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: I don’t like the idea of staying in a tent. It’d be too hot.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Right. And the tour ends in Las Vegas.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: OK.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: The other trip we can arrange is slightly different. It starts in San Francisco. Then you drive south to Cambria.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: Someone told me there’s a really nice castle near Cambria. Will we go near that?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Hearst Castle is on that road so you could stop there.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: Good. I’d like to do that. Does this trip also go into the desert?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: No, it continues to Santa Monica where most people like to stop and do some shopping.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: We have enough of that at home so that doesn’t interest us.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: OK. Well you could go straight on to San Diego.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: That’s good for beaches isn’t it?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: That’s right, that’s a good place to relax and your children might like to visit the zoo before flying home.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: I don’t think so. We want some time for sunbathing and swimming.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: So how many days are the trips and how much do they cost?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: The first one I told you about is a self-drive tour through California which lasts twelve days and covers 2,020 kilometres. The shortest journey is 206 km and the longest is 632 kilometres. The cost is £525 per person. That includes accommodation, car rental and a flight but no meals.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: OK. And the other trip?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: That lasts nine days but you spend only three days on the road. You cover about 980 kilometres altogether.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: So is that cheaper then?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: Yes, it’s almost a hundred pounds cheaper. It’s £429 per person, which is a good deal.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: So that covers accommodation and car hire. What about flights?

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: They aren’t included. But these hotels offer dinner in the price.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: OK. Well, thank you very much. I’ll be in touch when I’ve had a chance to look at the brochure.

segments.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
segments.text: I’m pleased to help. Goodbye.

segments.speaker: ANDREA
segments.text: Goodbye.
